title: Sparse Bounds for Rough Fourier Integral Operators
summary: We prove pointwise bounds for rough Fourier integral operators by the $L^p$ Hardy-Littlewood maximal function. We assume the Fourier integral operators have amplitudes in $L^\infty S^m_ρ$ and phases $\varphi$ such that $\varphi(x,ξ) - x\cdotξ\in L^\infty Φ^1$, and assume a non-degeneracy condition on the matrix $\partial^2_ξ\varphi(x,ξ)$. The pointwise bound holds when \begin{equation*} m < -\fracρ{2}(n-1) - \fracρ{p} - \frac{n}{p}(1-ρ), \end{equation*} which is known to a be sharp condition on $m$ when $ρ=1$, modulo the end-point.
